camel_example: aliyun ros ListChangeSets --region cn-hangzhou --Status.1 CREATE_COMPLETE --ChangeSetId '1f6521a4-05af-4975-afe9-bc4b45ad0000' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ChangeSetName.1 MyChangeSet --ExecutionStatus.1 AVAILABLE --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
description_en: Queries the details of created change sets
description_zh: 查询已创建的更改集列表详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros list-change-sets --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --change-set-id 1f6521a4-05af-4975-afe9-bc4b45ad0000 --status CREATE_COMPLETE --change-set-name MyChangeSet --execution-status AVAILABLE --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListChangeSets

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in paging query. The value must be an integer.
Valid values: 1 to 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。必须为整数。
取值范围：1~50。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the change set. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 更改集所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the change set list.  
Minimum value: 1.  
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
更改集列表的页码。  
起始值：1。  
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The change set ID. If you do not need detailed information about the change set, you can use this parameter instead of calling the GetChangeSet operation
parameters.help_zh: 更改集ID。如果不需要更改集详细信息，可使用此参数代替GetChangeSet接口
parameters.name: change_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the change set. Maximum value of N: 5. Valid values:
CREATE_PENDING
CREATE_IN_PROGRESS
CREATE_COMPLETE
CREATE_FAILED
DELETE_FAILED
DELETE_COMPLETE
parameters.help_zh:
更改集的状态。N的最大值为5。取值：
CREATE_PENDING
CREATE_IN_PROGRESS
CREATE_COMPLETE
CREATE_FAILED
DELETE_FAILED
DELETE_COMPLETE
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the change set. Maximum value of N: 5. You can use the wildcard character asterisk (*) for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 更改集的名称。N的最大值为5。支持使用通配符星号（*）进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: change_set_name

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the change set. Maximum value of N: 5. Valid values:
UNAVAILABLE
AVAILABLE
EXECUTE_IN_PROGRESS
EXECUTE_COMPLETE
EXECUTE_FAILED
OBSOLETE
parameters.help_zh:
更改集的执行状态。N的最大值为5。取值：
UNAVAILABLE
AVAILABLE
EXECUTE_IN_PROGRESS
EXECUTE_COMPLETE
EXECUTE_FAILED
OBSOLETE
parameters.name: execution_status
